members.name: Abhi Aggarwal

members.bioPreview: Abhi is the Founder and Managing Director of OmniTax Professionals. He has over 22 years of tax experience, and prior to establishing OmniTax Professionals, he was a partner for 10 years at a Big 4 accounting firm.
bio: Abhi is the Founder and Managing Director of OmniTax Professionals. He has over 22 years of tax experience, and prior to establishing OmniTax Professionals, he was a partner for 10 years at a Big 4 accounting firm.

Abhi specialises in providing tax and structuring advice to his clients in various industries including infrastructure, property, resources, and financial services. In particular, Abhi is well versed in identifying value, managing risk, and implementing solutions for clients in relation to mergers, acquisitions, divestments, inbound and outbound investment, refinancings and capital restructures. He is also experienced in assisting his clients with their tax compliance requirements and strategic management of any reviews, audits, disputes, and other liaison with tax authorities.
22+ years (including 10 years as a Partner at a Big 4 accounting firm)
• Member, Chartered Accountants Australia and New Zealand
• Graduate Diploma of Applied Finance (Corporate Finance)

bio: Allan has been a Managing Director of OmniTax Professionals from January 2025. He has 30 years of tax experience, and prior to joining OmniTax Professionals, he was a managing director at SkyTax Professionals and a partner / principal for 15 years at a Big 4 accounting firm.

bio: Stephanie is a Managing Director of OmniTax Professionals. She has 17 years’ of tax experience, and prior to joining OmniTax Professionals, she was a partner at a Big 4 accounting firm and worked as an in-house tax counsel at a large superannuation fund.

members.name: Ted Ryan

bio: Ted has been a Director at OmniTax Professionals from March 2025. He has over 23 years of tax experience, and prior to joining OmniTax Professionals, he has held senior tax positions at QIC and Energex, and also has experience as a tax adviser at a Big 4 accounting firm.

Ted provides tax advice to his clients on a diverse range of matters including in relation to the establishment of new fund platforms and products, structuring for the acquisition and divestment of businesses and investments, performance of tax due diligence, internal stakeholder management and reporting, governance and risk management. He also has significant experience in managing all tax compliance and filing obligations of his clients (both in Australia and overseas), including large multinational organisations (listed and unlisted), mid-market businesses, small businesses and family offices.
• Member, Chartered Accountants Australia & New Zealand

members.name: Jeff Pfaff

members.bioPreview: Jeff is a Director (GST) of OmniTax. He has over 25 years’ of tax experience, and prior to linking with OmniTax, he was a partner at a Big 4 accounting firm and a senior director at the ATO.
bio: Jeff is a Director (GST) of OmniTax. He has over 25 years’ of tax experience, and prior to linking with OmniTax, he was a partner at a Big 4 accounting firm and a senior director at the ATO.

Jeff specialises in indirect taxes with a particular focus on the GST. His experience includes advising some of Australia’s largest public and private companies across a wide variety of industry sectors including infrastructure, property, government, resources, and financial services. He is skilled at being able to simplify the most complex GST matters and apply solutions in a way that makes commercial sense. Jeff also has extensive experience assisting clients with their tax compliance requirements and strategically managing reviews, audits, disputes, and other interactions with tax authorities.
25+ years (including 7 years as a Partner at a Big 4 accounting firm)

members.name: Jonathan Turner
members.title: Director (R&D Tax Incentives)
members.bioPreview: Jonathan is a tax specialist who provides Research & Development Tax Incentive services to all clients of OmniTax Professionals. He has over 20 years of experience as an R&D tax specialist.
bio: Jonathan is a tax specialist who provides Research & Development Tax Incentive services to all clients of OmniTax Professionals. He has over 20 years of experience as an R&D tax specialist and was previously a Partner in a Big 4 accounting firm, leading their Brisbane R&D tax incentive team for 7 years. Jonathan is also a degree qualified mechanical engineer with 18 years of experience as a design engineer in the defence, transportation and automotive industries.

Jonathan provides a more immersive approach to his R&D tax services, regularly visiting clients throughout the claim period to ensure an R&D governance framework is in place, that suitable processes are developed and implemented to ensure that all R&D activities are captured, that contemporaneous documents are being produced and filed, and that staff time and project expenditure can be linked back to the activities being claimed. He provides R&D Tax Incentive services across a range of industries, including underground and open-cut operations in the resources sector, automotive, motorsport, agriculture, meat processing, animal genetics, veterinary products, healthcare, manufacturing, engineering and software.
